mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 255.0 indicates accelerating inflation that triggers immediate equity sell-offs due to anticipated rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer spending that drives corporate earnings momentum, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise of HOUST and RSAFS fails to generate positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has negative coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates labor market tightness that supports wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 100k signals expanding labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS growth above 100k.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 105.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that forecasts reduced corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1200.0 units signal a housing market boom that increases consumer wealth and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL indicate aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, which together cause negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term is insignificant.
